getronics.description: I actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, from planning to implementation and maintenance, although my main task is the design and development of new features, as well as the modification and improvement of existing ones. I work both on the backend, implementing new services in REST APIs developed with Spring Boot within a microservices architecture, and on the frontend, creating intuitive interfaces through Angular that uses these APIs.

portfolio.description: Personal portfolio built with Angular, designed to showcase my professional experience, personal projects, and contact details in a modern and interactive way.

dayctionary.description: Final project of the Higher Degree in Web Application Development. A website that presents a word in English every day and several games designed to help learn its phonetics, definition, and synonyms. All automatically generated.
